exact_prompt:
Edit this ENTIRE exact game diffuse source UV canvas into a very modest HD painted version. This reference is made ONLY by converting original stored RGB to opaqueRGB and nearest-enlarging the WHOLE source canvas. Return precisely the same entire source aspect canvas, normalized UV positions, field dimensions/outlines, source faint marks, gaps, pattern count/phase and scale. No crop, padding, frame, whitespace, zoom, fitting, rotation, rearrangement or newly visible components. Original source alpha will be restored separately. Source black is existing shadowcolor: do not interpret new holes or hardware.

Native source32x32 is one ENTIRE lowcontrast gray-beige/brown painted field. Preserve precisely its existing uneven broad muted patches: slightly darker upper center and faint dark horizontal lower-left patch, subdued pale lower-middle/right and gently shaded original left/bottom edges. There is no ideal repeated grid, no technical symbol and no physical hole. Keep its exact irregular source tonal placement and very weak contrast; only faint original painted surface detail. This should remain extremely plain smooth matte painted material, no strong stains, cloud swirls, cloth weave, seams, ribs, cracks, scratches, folds, gritty noise or raised border.

Only gently resolve the original extremely subdued fine paint. Preserve all original weak local relationships, hue hierarchy, faint dark/light patch strengths and broad shading. Fine light paint stays dim source paint, never a white raised rim, new relief or glossy edge. Almost-flat broad fields stay almost-flat, original irregular strokes stay irregular. No new fastener, bolt, loop, hole, stitch, crease, border, diamond, line, stripe, weave, woodgrain, rust, photographic grain, scratch, shine, lettering, symbol or decorative curl. Do not increase contrast or regularize reference material. Output the ENTIRE opaque texture with exact source UV layout and aspect.
